```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

## Purpose

This aggregates the per-cancer overall-survival (OS) results saved by the
survival script (`survival_deviation_results-<feature_set>.rds`) into a single
supplementary table. Each per-cancer file already stores the age-adjusted Cox
hazard ratio for Deviation and the scaled-Schoenfeld (`cox.zph`) proportional-
hazards diagnostics, so nothing is recomputed here. The table reports the
hazard ratio per additional year of Deviation alongside the per-coefficient and
global PH p-values, and flags any cancer where the assumption is not met.

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(here)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(knitr)
  library(reactable)
})

msg <- function(...) if (isTRUE(params$verbose)) message(...)
```

## Cancers of interest

These are the cross-cancer emphasis set, each paired with its GTEx tissue of
origin. Add or remove rows here to change which cancers enter the table.

```{r}
map <- list(
  BRCA = "BREAST",
  LUSC = "LUNG",
  LUAD = "LUNG",
  GBM  = "BRAIN",
  LGG  = "BRAIN",
  COAD = "COLON"
)
```

## Load saved OS results

```{r}
suffix       <- paste0("-", params$feature_set)
out_root_abs <- here::here(params$out_root)

os_list <- list()

for (tcga in names(map)) {
  gtex        <- map[[tcga]]
  analysis_id <- paste0(tcga, "__", gtex)
  res_path    <- file.path(out_root_abs, analysis_id,
                           paste0("survival_deviation_results", suffix, ".rds"))

  if (!file.exists(res_path)) {
    warning("Missing survival results for ", analysis_id, " (", res_path, "); skipping.")
    next
  }

  res <- readRDS(res_path)
  os  <- res$surv_res_os

  if (is.null(os) || nrow(os) == 0) {
    warning("No OS result stored for ", analysis_id, "; skipping.")
    next
  }

  # tag cancer/tissue so the stacked table is self-describing
  os$tcga_project <- tcga
  os$gtex_project <- gtex
  os_list[[tcga]] <- os
}

os_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(os_list)
msg("Loaded OS results for ", nrow(os_all), " cancers.")
```

## Build the diagnostic table

A cancer is flagged "Violated" if either the Deviation-specific or the global
Schoenfeld p-value falls below `ph_alpha` (default 0.05). Rows are ordered by
hazard ratio to mirror the cross-cancer forest.

```{r}
ph_alpha <- params$ph_alpha

os_table <- os_all %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Cancer                 = tcga_project,
    Tissue                 = gtex_project,
    n                      = n,
    Events                 = events,
    HR_per_yr              = HR_per1yr_dev,
    CI_low                 = CI_low,
    CI_high                = CI_high,
    p_value                = p_value,
    Schoenfeld_p_deviation = zph_dev_p,
    Schoenfeld_p_global    = zph_global_p,
    # Flag on the deviation-specific test only: this is the term the HR reports.
    # The global p is kept visible below but does not drive the flag, since a
    # global violation can be carried by the age covariate rather than deviation.
    Deviation_PH = dplyr::if_else(
      is.finite(zph_dev_p) & zph_dev_p < ph_alpha,
      "Violated", "Met"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(HR_per_yr)

# manuscript-facing formatted view
os_print <- os_table %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    `HR (95% CI)`              = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f\u2013%.3f)", HR_per_yr, CI_low, CI_high),
    `p`                        = signif(p_value, 3),
    `Schoenfeld p (deviation)` = signif(Schoenfeld_p_deviation, 3),
    `Schoenfeld p (global)`    = signif(Schoenfeld_p_global, 3)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Cancer, Tissue, n, Events, `HR (95% CI)`, `p`,
                `Schoenfeld p (deviation)`, `Schoenfeld p (global)`, Deviation_PH)
```

## Table

```{r}
reactable::reactable(
  os_print,
  searchable = TRUE, resizable = TRUE, striped = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE, defaultPageSize = 12
)

knitr::kable(
  os_print,
  caption = "Overall-survival Cox results for tumor Deviation (age-adjusted), with scaled-Schoenfeld proportional-hazards diagnostics."
)
```

```{r}
violated <- os_table$Cancer[os_table$Deviation_PH == "Violated"]
if (length(violated) == 0) {
  msg("Deviation-term PH assumption met for all cancers of interest.")
} else {
  msg("Deviation-term PH assumption not met for: ", paste(violated, collapse = ", "))
}
```

The proportional-hazards assumption for the Deviation term held for all cancers
of interest except
`r if (length(violated)) paste(violated, collapse = ", ") else "none"`, whose
hazard ratio is reported as a time-averaged effect.

## Save table

```{r}
## Save table

tables_root_abs <- here::here(params$tables_root)
dir.create(tables_root_abs, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

fmt_p <- function(x) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(x),
    NA_character_,
    ifelse(
      x < 1e-4,
      format(x, digits = 3, scientific = TRUE, trim = TRUE),
      format(signif(x, 3), scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
    )
  )
}

os_print <- os_table %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    `HR (95% CI)` = sprintf(
      "%.3f (%.3f-%.3f)",
      HR_per_yr, CI_low, CI_high
    ),
    `p` = fmt_p(p_value),
    `Schoenfeld p (deviation)` = fmt_p(Schoenfeld_p_deviation),
    `Schoenfeld p (global)` = fmt_p(Schoenfeld_p_global)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Cancer, Tissue, n, Events, `HR (95% CI)`, `p`,
    `Schoenfeld p (deviation)`,
    `Schoenfeld p (global)`,
    Deviation_PH
  )

utils::write.csv(
  os_print,
  file = file.path(tables_root_abs, "Supplement_OS_PH_diagnostics.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

msg(
  "Saved: ",
  file.path(tables_root_abs, "Supplement_OS_PH_diagnostics.csv")
)
```
